_note: GE HealthCare spin-off effectif Jan 2023, historique public limite a 3 ans (FY22-24). Segmentation revue en 2025 : 4 segments (Imaging / AVS / PCS / PDx) au lieu de 5.

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment GEHC (~45% CA) : IRM, scanners CT, rayons X. Recul FY24 lie aux volumes Chine.
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Imaging : IRM, scanners CT, rayons X, mammographie. Premier segment GE HealthCare (~45% du CA). Recul FY24 du au ralentissement marche chinois.
kpis.description_en: Imaging segment revenue: MRI, CT scanners, X-ray, mammography. GEHC's largest segment (~45% of revenue). FY24 decline due to China market slowdown.

kpis.signal: Segment AVS : ultrasons + visualisation chirurgicale + cardiologie interventionnelle, croissance organique stable
kpis.description_fr: CA segment AVS : ultrasons (Voluson, Logiq, Vivid), visualisation chirurgicale, cardiologie interventionnelle. Issu de la refonte 2025 ex-Ultrasound.
kpis.description_en: AVS segment revenue: ultrasound (Voluson, Logiq, Vivid), surgical visualization, interventional cardiology. Result of 2025 reorganization from ex-Ultrasound segment.

kpis.signal: PCS : monitoring patient + anesthesie + soins maternels. Marche mature, croissance faible.
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Patient Care Solutions : monitoring patient (ECG, anesthesie, ventilation) + soins maternels. Marche relativement mature.
kpis.description_en: PCS segment revenue: patient monitoring (ECG, anesthesia, ventilation) + maternal care. Mature market with low single-digit growth.

kpis.signal: Segment a plus forte croissance (~13% CAGR) : agents de contraste IRM/CT, marge elevee, leader mondial
kpis.description_fr: CA segment PDx : agents de contraste pour IRM, CT et imagerie nucleaire (Omnipaque, Visipaque, Optison). Segment a plus forte croissance et marges les plus elevees du portefeuille.
kpis.description_en: PDx segment revenue: contrast agents for MRI, CT and nuclear imaging (Omnipaque, Visipaque, Optison). Highest-growth and highest-margin segment in the portfolio.

kpis.signal: Croissance ralentie FY24 (+0.6%) sous l'effet Chine, soutenue par services (+3%) et PDx
kpis.description_fr: CA total GE HealthCare (4 segments + Other). Croissance limitee FY24 par recul volumes Chine, compensee partiellement par hausse de prix services.
kpis.description_en: Total GE HealthCare revenue (4 segments + Other). FY24 growth limited by China volume decline, partially offset by services pricing.
